scripts.setup: uv python install 3.11 && uv venv --python 3.11 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/Scripts/python.exe -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: node tools/py.js -m pytest tests -q && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/editor-core.test.js tests/editor-dsp.test.js tests/server.test.js tests/sample.test.js
scripts.test:fast: node tools/py.js -m pytest tests -q -k "not smoke" && node --test tests/editor-core.test.js tests/editor-dsp.test.js
